note: City of Barnesville campground off Hwy 34, half a mile from I-94, beside a small meandering creek; Blue Eagle Lake's public beach, fishing pier and picnic grounds are within walking distance. Monthly and seasonal stays are also sold. Water at the sites is not guaranteed after October 1. --Claude
